yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm do a little dance? 🕺 Cocktail Sort (also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort) is exactly that! We're diving deep into how this fascinating sorting algorithm works, visualizing its 'bouncing' action from both ends. Is it just a fancy Bubble Sort, or does it have hidden powers? 🤔 Watch to find out how Cocktail Sort can sometimes outperform its simpler cousin, especially on nearly sorted arrays! We'll break down the logic, show you a step-by-step visualization, and discuss its pros and cons. Perfect for your next coding challenge or just to impress your tech friends! 🚀
